summary: This year, Studio Bagno is leading the charge with an extensive collection of new releases direct from Italy, available in a rich palette of Gloss Colour. Design with absolute freedom.
title: New Gloss Colour Releases, Direct From Italy
bodyHtml:
Rethink Gloss Colour in the Bathroom

This season, Studio Bagno leads the return of gloss coloured ceramic. Our newest gloss palettes, sourced directly from Italy’s design fairs, signal a strong European design demand and a fresh dimension for Australian bathrooms.

More than a finish, gloss introduces light, depth, and uniqueness —transforming essential objects into focal points of the room.

Explore our New Gloss Colour Arrivals


The Nur 82 Vanity Top / Wall Hung Basin in Gloss Tobasco

New Gloss Colour Basins

Our latest gloss releases elevate basin design with bold clarity. Our brand new Shard X range offers a contemporary statement, now available in gloss colours to amplify their striking geometry.

Our new Hyde series pairs organic softness with a gorgeous gloss colour offering, while our new Idilla Basins mark a new design direction, enhanced by a timeless gloss colour palette that takes its bold curvature to the next level.


Shard X 50 in Gloss Petrol


Idilla Oval in Gloss Myrtle

New Gloss Toilets

The Monolith Vortex Flush series showcases a bold interplay of high-gloss sophistication with advanced flushing performance, while the Futura Gloss Colour Pans embody minimalist design elevated by the reflective depth of the finished surface.

Together, they transform functional elements into architectural statements, reinforcing gloss as a defining feature of tomorrow’s bathroom.


Monolith Vortex Flush in Gloss Grey


Futura Vortex Flush in Gloss Colours

Design Expression

More than a finish, gloss is a design language in itself. Our latest collection interprets that language with precision, ensuring each piece contributes to a cohesive vision that brings richness and elegance into the bathroom landscape.
